theDuelist:EgyptVillage.NAME: Desert Village
DESCRIPTIONS: The air turns dry and hot as you step into a narrow market street. NL Sand crunches underfoot - somehow, a whole desert has been wedged into the Spire. NL A jeweler waves you over, smiling like they’ve been expecting you. NL #y"Adventurer! Rare bracelets, rings, and amulets... perfect for surviving harsh places." NL Yugi squints at the dunes. #y"How is there even... a desert up here?"

You slide the gold across the counter. The jeweler snaps the clasp into place with practiced ease. NL The metal feels warm for a moment, then settles - like it’s syncing to your heartbeat. NL #y"May it serve you well" the jeweler says, already reaching for the next display. NL You turn to leave, the sandstorm outside suddenly feeling... a little less threatening.

You shake your head and step away from the counter. NL The jeweler only shrugs, unbothered. #y"Come back when you’re ready." NL As you walk out, the market sounds fade behind you, swallowed by wind and sand. NL Yugi glances back once more. #y"I don’t like how normal that felt..."
